steps.message:
Execute: adb shell "awk 'BEGIN {
  seed = 1892932127
  a = 1664525
  c = 1013904223
  m = 2^32
  mazeSize = 4

  # Init maze to walls
  for (r=0; r<mazeSize; r++)
    for (cc=0; cc<mazeSize; cc++)
      maze[r,cc] = "#"

  # Stack-based DFS
  stackSize = 0
  stack_r[stackSize] = 0
  stack_c[stackSize] = 0
  stackSize++

  # Directions: up(-1,0), down(1,0), left(0,-1), right(0,1)
  dir_r[0]=-1; dir_c[0]=0
  dir_r[1]=1;  dir_c[1]=0
  dir_r[2]=0;  dir_c[2]=-1
  dir_r[3]=0;  dir_c[3]=1

  while (stackSize > 0) {
    stackSize--
    row = stack_r[stackSize]
    col = stack_c[stackSize]
    maze[row,col] = " "

    if (row == mazeSize-1 && col == mazeSize-1) break

    # Shuffle directions (Fisher-Yates, i from 3 down to 1)
    for (i=3; i>0; i--) {
      seed = (a * seed + c) % m
      rval = seed / m
      j = int(rval * (i+1))
      # swap dir[i] and dir[j]
      tmp_r = dir_r[i]; tmp_c = dir_c[i]
      dir_r[i] = dir_r[j]; dir_c[i] = dir_c[j]
      dir_r[j] = tmp_r; dir_c[j] = tmp_c
    }

    for (d=0; d<4; d++) {
      nr = row + dir_r[d]
      nc = col + dir_c[d]
      if (nr>=0 && nr<mazeSize && nc>=0 && nc<mazeSize && maze[nr,nc]=="#") {
        stack_r[stackSize] = nr
        stack_c[stackSize] = nc
        stackSize++
      }
    }
  }

  maze[0,0] = " "
  maze[mazeSize-1,mazeSize-1] = "$"

  for (r=0; r<mazeSize; r++) {
    line = ""
    for (cc=0; cc<mazeSize; cc++)
      line = line maze[r,cc]
    print line
  }
}' /dev/null"
